name: hud_ui_element_draw
description: HudUiElement::Draw executes the authored HudUiElement class draw method.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison for ?Draw@HudUiElement@@UAEXXZ at 0x404ca0 passes with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and source both model 0x404ca0 as the HudUiElement class Draw method calling DrawBase.
The native smoke constructs a real HudUiElement, calls HudUiElement::Draw with null and non-null bltSource values, and captures the provider blit callback reached through DrawBase.
